title: Tomintoul 1967 Silvano's Collection 50 Year Old 50th Anniversary, 45.2% ABV (GB)
seen_in_photos: Round dark-glass onion-shaped decanter bottle, black capsule, black neck label with tassel cord, black hang tag, wooden box with brass plate.
text_read: Neck label: 1968 ANNIVERSARY 50 YEARS OLD; Single Malt Scotch Whisky; 1967 Tomintoul casks No.4688 & 5425; Bottled in Scotland in 2018; 45,2 % vol; 70 cl. Tag: 'Dear Friends, I am honoured to share with you the project of my beloved husband Silvano with whom I had an extraordinary work experience. His bottlings became legendary and with this Tomintoul 1967, we celebrate 50 years of his activity. Thanks for your loyalty. Maryse Accorsi Samaroli'.
not_in_title: Samaroli connection (Silvano Samaroli, tag signed by his widow Maryse Accorsi Samaroli); two casks vatted, Nos. 4688 and 5425; bottled 2018; 1968 anniversary reference; 70cl. bottling_era: Bottled 2018 (label), 50th anniversary of Samaroli, modern decanter-style bottle.
condition: Fill into neck and capsule intact from photos; spirit dark and clear; no obvious damage. Box present.
unreadable: Bottom of the neck label and the cask line is partly hidden by the tag and cord.
